doc.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Charlie Christian and Django as influences
summary: Charlie Christian was the biggest influence though Ellis never saw him live.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Would you say that Charlie Christian was an influence for you?
Absolutely. And Django Rinehardt to some degree, but Charlie was the biggest influence.
How many opportunities did you have to see him?
He had such a short career, didn’t he?
Yeah. I think he died when he was 21.
